title: Coefficient 2 at exponent 1 for the total family MOD3: full supplied proof of C_B2(f_n) >= 2n - 8

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total language L of proof.md Part A: MOD3. For every integer n >= 0 and every x in {0,1}^n, f_n(x) = 1 iff the Hamming weight of x is congruent to 0 modulo 3. Thus f_0(empty) = 1 (empty sum 0), f_1 = 1 exactly on the all-zero string, and in general f_n is the characteristic function of the ternary residue of the weight. One fixed deterministic linear-time evaluator computes f_n at every length: scan the input, maintain the weight modulo 3, compare with 0. One fixed verifier accepts exactly the empty witness on yes-inputs.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"2"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"2"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one fixed total uniform polynomial-time family, which lies in P and hence in NP with empty witnesses, and whose circuits are required to compute f_n exactly on every input in the full Li-Yang B2 model, C_B2(f_n) >= 2n - 8 holds at every integer length n >= 4. Hence liminf over all integers n of C_B2(f_n)/n is at least 2, and for every epsilon > 0 the explicit threshold N_epsilon = max(4, ceil(8/epsilon)) makes C_B2(f_n) >= (2 - epsilon)*n hold for every integer n >= N_epsilon.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
